title: BOX OF SUSIE COOPER PART TEA S...
reason: Genuine Susie Cooper bone china signature backstamp on a complete-looking tea set with teapot for four; collectable designer name (my estimate A$80-180).
findings: Susie Cooper Bone China tea set for four: white ground with scattered pale blue star or snowflake sprigs and gold dots, gilt rims, handles and foot rings. Pieces seen: teapot with lid, milk jug, sugar bowl, 4 cups, 4 saucers, 6 tea plates (4 with the trios plus 2 loose) and a handled cake plate, about 18 pieces. Backstamp (photo 2): printed brown facsimile signature 'Susie Cooper' with an underline and asterisk motif above 'BONE CHINA ENGLAND'; the mark style points to the 1950s to 1960s (my reading, not checked against a backstamp guide). Pattern name or number is not legible in the single base photo.
condition: Gilding looks intact with only light rub; no chips, cracks or crazing seen at photo resolution; teapot lid and spout look undamaged.
rescore_note: Genuine Susie Cooper bone china signature backstamp (asterisk mark style of about 1950 to 1966) on a complete-looking tea set for four with teapot and no damage seen, but the pattern is plain and Susie Cooper bone china sells modestly; my estimate $100 to 180.
